text:
sam: Quick triage  perf spike in canary last night. We need a targeted cut so launch base stays on track. Suggestion: ship MVP = chat + embeddings + basic moderation. Defer admin analytics, tenant routing, and long-term convo history to v1.

lee: Agreed on priorities. Two clarifying q's: does billing hook count as a blocker for paid tenants? And are webhooks in or out?

nora: Billing hooks must stay for paid onboarding. Webhooks are low-traffic and can be deferred. Also infra: removing tenant routing cuts steady-state CPU by ~15%.

rafa: If we cut analytics, support will need a read-only logs endpoint for debugging. Low effort (feature-flagged). I can scope the support shim.

emma: Heads-up from sales: one trial customer uses tenant routing today. If we delay, they may push launch. We could offer a short-term pilot with feature-flag access.

sam: Ok plan: keep billing hooks and webhooks off the critical path. Cut admin analytics and long-term history. Offer pilot access to up to 2 customers for tenant routing if sales requests. We need to lock scope by EOD.

lee: I'll open a PR to gate analytics behind a flag and add a small support-logs shim. ETA 6pm.

nora: I'll scale down the extra nodes and reassign the reserved GPU to other pools, monitor canary for 24h.

rafa: I'll update release notes + handbook text. Draft: "Deferred features: admin analytics, tenant routing (pilot exceptions), conversation history beyond 7 days."

deploy-bot: release plan updated: branch release/2026-06-01 -> staging at 2026-05-30 09:00 UTC.

sam: Final call: lock scope to chat + embeddings + moderation + billing hooks. Defer admin analytics, tenant routing (pilot exceptions only), long-term history. Action items: Lee PR, Nora infra reassign, Rafa comms. Locking now unless objections.

emma: Fine from sales. I'll compile list of interested customers and route pilot requests to Sam.

lee: PR opened: github.com/redwood/release/pull/678 (tests pass). Notes in PR for QA.

sam: Thanks  locking scope now and will post final update in handbook.
